# aos7-evgap

唯讀彙總 node 目錄中的 obs、must JSONL 記錄與 state.json；不修復或修改輸入。

## 第一次跑

從原型根目錄執行：

```sh
python3 packs/evgap/bin/aos7-evgap <node資料夾>
```

成功時 stdout 恰有一行 JSON；資料夾不存在或參數不是資料夾時，退出碼為 2 且 stdout 為空。只讀取名稱符合 `<channel>.<12位數字>.jsonl` 的一般檔案，以及 `<channel>.active.jsonl`；不讀取其他檔名。路徑以輸入資料夾為基準。

程式見 [aos7_evgap.py](aos7_evgap.py)，入口見 [bin/aos7-evgap](bin/aos7-evgap)，測試見 [tests/test_evgap.py](tests/test_evgap.py)。

從儲存庫根目錄執行驗證：

```sh
python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/evgap/tests
python3 check_answer.py proto7-2 packs/author/examples/aos-tool-gap/fixture
```

"""Black-box tests for the read-only evgap CLI."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-evgap"


class EvgapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.node = Path(self.temp.name) / "node"
        self.node.mkdir()

    def put(self, name, data):
        path = self.node / name
        path.write_bytes(data)
        return path

    def run_cli(self, path=None):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(self.node if path is None else path)],
                              stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)

    def result(self):
        process = self.run_cli()
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, process.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(process.stdout.count(b"\n"), 1)
        self.assertTrue(process.stdout.endswith(b"\n"))
        return json.loads(process.stdout)

    def test_absent_state_and_empty_channels(self):
        self.put("obs.000000000001.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n')
        self.put("obs.1.jsonl", b'{"seq":90}\n')
        self.put("must.other.jsonl", b'{"seq":90}\n')
        result = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"v", "channels", "bad"})
        self.assertIs(type(result["v"]), int)
        self.assertEqual(result["v"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(set(result["channels"]), {"obs", "must"})
        self.assertEqual(result["bad"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["channels"]["obs"], {
            "count": 1, "first": 1, "last": 1, "missing": [], "dup": [],
            "next_seq": None, "unacked": None, "stale_next": None})
        self.assertEqual(result["channels"]["must"], {
            "count": 0, "first": None, "last": None, "missing": [], "dup": [],
            "next_seq": None, "unacked": None, "stale_next": None})

    def test_bad_lines_duplicates_and_numeric_order(self):
        self.put("obs.000000000010.jsonl", b'{"seq":2}\n{"seq":true}\n{"seq":3}\n{"seq":4')
        self.put("obs.000000000002.jsonl",
                 b'{"seq":1}\n{"seq":NaN}\n{"seq":1}\n{"seq":null}\n'
                 b'{"seq":5}\n{"seq":2}\n{"seq":2}\n{"seq":\r 7}\n')
        self.put("obs.active.jsonl", b'[]\n{"seq":1.0}\n{"seq":Infinity}\n{"seq":8}\n')
        self.put("must.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":3}\n{"seq":3}\n{"seq":5}\n')
        self.put("state.json", b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":10},'
                               b'"must":{"next_seq":6,"acked_upto":3}}}')
        result = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(result["channels"]["obs"], {
            "count": 9, "first": 1, "last": 8, "missing": [[4, 4], [6, 6]],
            "dup": [1, 2], "next_seq": 10, "unacked": None, "stale_next": True})
        self.assertEqual(result["channels"]["must"], {
            "count": 3, "first": 3, "last": 5, "missing": [[4, 4]],
            "dup": [3], "next_seq": 6, "unacked": 1, "stale_next": False})
        self.assertEqual(result["bad"], [
            {"file": "obs.000000000002.jsonl", "line": 2, "why": "bad_json"},
            {"file": "obs.000000000002.jsonl", "line": 4, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.000000000010.jsonl", "line": 2, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.000000000010.jsonl", "line": 4, "why": "torn"},
            {"file": "obs.active.jsonl", "line": 1, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.active.jsonl", "line": 2, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.active.jsonl", "line": 3, "why": "bad_json"}])

    def test_state_errors_are_reported_once_and_isolated(self):
        self.put("obs.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":2}\n')
        self.put("must.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":2}\n')
        path = self.put("state.json", b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":3},'
                                      b'"must":{"next_seq":true,"acked_upto":0}}}')
        result = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(result["bad"], [{"file": "state.json", "line": None, "why": "bad_state"}])
        self.assertEqual(result["channels"]["obs"]["stale_next"], False)
        self.assertEqual(result["channels"]["obs"]["next_seq"], 3)
        for key in ("next_seq", "unacked", "stale_next"):
            self.assertIsNone(result["channels"]["must"][key])
        path.write_bytes(b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":3},"must":')
        result = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(result["bad"], [{"file": "state.json", "line": None, "why": "bad_state"}])
        for channel in ("obs", "must"):
            for key in ("next_seq", "unacked", "stale_next"):
                self.assertIsNone(result["channels"][channel][key])

    def test_read_only_even_when_node_is_not_writable(self):
        self.put("must.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n')
        self.put("state.json", b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":1},'
                               b'"must":{"next_seq":2,"acked_upto":0}}}')
        self.node.chmod(0o555)
        self.addCleanup(lambda: self.node.chmod(0o755))

        def snapshot():
            return {path.name: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_size,
                                path.stat().st_mode, path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                    for path in self.node.iterdir()}

        before = snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(self.result()["channels"]["must"]["unacked"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(), before)
        self.assertEqual(os.stat(self.node).st_mode & 0o777, 0o555)

    def test_invalid_folder_has_no_stdout(self):
        missing = self.run_cli(self.node / "missing")
        self.assertEqual((missing.returncode, missing.stdout), (2, b""))
        file_path = self.put("input.txt", b"text")
        regular_file = self.run_cli(file_path)
        self.assertEqual((regular_file.returncode, regular_file.stdout), (2, b""))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
